text: Alchemy Objective: Global retailer looking to drive 20% YoY growth in markets & products.
material: simulated case brief

text: Alchemy (alchemy.com) is a global B2C retailer, that is publicly owned and headquartered in the US, with an extensive line of cosmetic products. Right now, it operates in North America (NA), Europe and APAC. The products vary by geographical region, their operations take into account local labor laws and pricing reflects what local consumers are willing/able to pay. The organization has individual sales and marketing departments by geographical region, and local IT and data departments who provide their local operations teams with the reporting that they need. This reporting is created ad-hoc and fresh every time, including alignment on key terms and metrics as how those are defined will differ by BU and by geography. It has aimed to modernize its regional data platforms and the analytics that feed off of them. Several challenges have been documented so far, including:
material: simulated case brief

text: Decisions at the corporate, enterprise level require time-consuming report development, that is not always trusted and so gets limited usage.
material: simulated case brief

text: IT has a sizable budget to invest in foundational technology and is exploring an array of reporting and catalog options. A shadow IT team has sprung up in APAC and is doing the same, due to a perceived lack of support from corporate.
material: simulated case brief

text: A Senior Manager in IT is responsible for determining which centralized reports are pushed out, cataloging assets, and is the only person that knows the history of how customer data has been managed and why certain rules are applied.
material: simulated case brief

text: A progressive VP of Analytics is exploring how AI can enable future progress, and is experimenting with POCs without business engagement. The aim is to showcase what the capability can bring to organizational growth.
material: simulated case brief

text: First drafts of reports going out to Wall Street tend to contain inconsistencies and require multiple hours of review and resolution, including significant time investment from the CFO. Additional views are built out through back-and-forth.
material: simulated case brief

text: It takes Sales data 72 hours to refresh due to the patchwork, organic growth of the foundational architecture.
material: simulated case brief

text: There is a perspective in NA that it is critical to build a Customer 360. As a result, IT has placed Customer MDM first on their roadmap for the year.
material: simulated case brief

text: Looking forward, Alchemy would like to be more strategic about its growth, new product lines, how they price their products, their consumer marketing efforts and where they invest in foundational infrastructure and operations to get there.
material: simulated case brief

text: The Corporate CIO has reached out to the business in NA, and collectively they have called us in to help. Both CIO and Chief Sales Officer have asked their leaders in NA, to find an external partner who can guide them on their roadmap for the next 2-3 years, and set direction. They need help understanding what sequence they should make investments into their foundation in, and they would like a vision and recommendations for the future. They both also want to get to value and “tangible” outputs quickly. We are in a competitive bidding process alongside two other vendors. So far the client has shared their challenges, and no clear scope of work, although they want us to come to the table with an approach and team based on our experience.

question: What are your top 2-3 business priorities for the next 12 months?
text: Our top priorities are to hit 20% YoY growth in priority markets, expand the product mix where we already have demand, and improve margin while we grow. I also need faster executive visibility so we can see where growth is real versus where we are just pushing volume without profit.
